These findings directly confirm Samsung's role in manufacturing HBM chips used in AI accelerators.

findings.claim: Samsung Electronics signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with AMD to expand their strategic collaboration on next-generation AI memory, aligning on primary HBM4 supply for the AMD Instinct MI455X GPU.
findings.quote: Samsung Electronics today announced it has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with AMD to expand their strategic collaboration on next-generation AI memory...Samsung and AMD will align on primary HBM4 supply for the AMD Instinct MI455X GPU

findings.claim: As of September 2025, Samsung passed NVIDIA's qualification for HBM3E 12-Hi (12-layer), becoming the third supplier after SK Hynix and Micron.
findings.quote: Samsung finally passed NVIDIA's 12-layer HBM3E qualification in September 2025 — third supplier, after SK Hynix and Micron

findings.claim: SK Hynix is planning to begin mass production of its HBM4 16-Hi devices (48 gigabytes capacity) in the third quarter of 2026.
findings.quote: At CES 2026, SK Hynix unveiled a 16-layer HBM4 device with 48 gigabytes of capacity... SK Hynix is planning to begin mass production of these HBM4 devices in the third quarter of 2026.

findings.claim: Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron have extended their order books into 2027 due to the highest-ever gap between DRAM demand and supply.
findings.quote: The three companies that control more than 90 percent of global DRAM — Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron — simultaneously warned of multi-year shortages as their order books extended into 2027.

findings.claim: All three major HBM suppliers (SK Hynix, Samsung, and Micron) had their 2026 production fully sold out before the late 2025 summit.
findings.quote: In the short term, no. All three major HBM suppliers — SK Hynix, Samsung, and Micron — had their 2026 production fully sold out before Friday's summit.

findings.claim: Meaningful new HBM capacity is not expected until 2027 or 2028 from facilities currently under construction.
findings.quote: Meaningful new HBM capacity is not expected until 2027 or 2028 from new facilities currently under construction.

findings.claim: SK Hynix holds a 50-55% revenue share in the global HBM market as of August 2026, leading ahead of Samsung and Micron.
findings.quote: SK Hynix leads the global HBM market with a 50-55% revenue share as of August 2026, ahead of Samsung and Micron, the only two other qualified HBM suppliers worldwide.

findings.claim: In early 2026, SK hynix leads the manufacturer leaderboard for HBM, while Samsung trails on HBM3E and is racing on HBM4.
findings.quote: SK hynix leads, Samsung trails on HBM3E and is racing on HBM4, and Micron has overtaken Samsung on some allocations.

findings.claim: As of July 2026, the 2026 supplier set for HBM memory is led by SK hynix, Samsung, and Micron, with SK hynix holding the dominant share on HBM3E.
findings.quote: The 2026 supplier set is led by SK hynix, Samsung, and Micron, with SK hynix holding the dominant share on HBM3E and pre-qualifying HBM4.

findings.claim: SK Hynix was the first to qualify HBM3E in 2024, preceding Samsung at the 12-Hi tier.
findings.quote: Micron qualified HBM3E in 2024 - later than SK Hynix, earlier than Samsung at the 12-Hi tier - and is the only non-Korean qualified supplier.

findings.claim: Samsung is expected to qualify on the HBM4 generation at the same tier as SK Hynix by late 2026 or early 2027.
findings.quote: If Samsung qualifies on the HBM4 generation (expected late 2026 / early 2027) at the same tier as SK Hynix, capacity gets bigger and the price-floor under HBM3E weakens.

findings.claim: Micron is the only non-Korean supplier qualified for HBM3E and has a business growing over 100% year-on-year.
findings.quote: Capacity is the smallest of the three; Micron's HBM business is growing 100%+ year-on-year off a small base.

findings.claim: Samsung Electronics manufactures High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) chips optimized for high-performance computing and next-generation technologies.
findings.quote: Meet HBM(High Bandwidth Memory) optimized for high-performance computing(HPC) and next-generation technologies with better capacity, bandwidth, and low voltage.

findings.claim: Samsung Electronics developed the industry's first 12-stack HBM3E DRAM in February 2024.
findings.quote: In February, 2024, Samsung Electronics announced the development of the 36GB HBM3E 12H (5th generation HBM), the industry's first 12-stack HBM3E DRAM.

findings.claim: Samsung Electronics plans to supply HBM4 chips to OpenAI for use in its first in-house artificial intelligence processor.
findings.quote: Samsung Electronics plans to supply its next-generation high-bandwidth memory (HBM4) chips to OpenAI for use in the ChatGPT maker's first in-house artificial intelligence processor.
